text:
maya: FYI customer hit a 422 + weird all-zero scores on /v1/rerank, stack trace attached. they sent a big documents array and put their query object inside each doc instead of at root.

alex: can you paste the payload (redact ids)?

maya: sure — minimal repro we got from them:
```json
{
  \"documents\": [
    {\"id\": \"d1\", \"title\": \"Intro\", \"query\": \"what is X\", \"text\": \"...\"},
    {\"id\": \"d2\", \"title\": \"Usage\", \"query\": \"what is X\", \"text\": \"...\"}
  ],
  \"candidates\": [\"d1\", \"d2\"]
}
```
maya: response was 422 with body: `{ \"error\": \"invalid schema: missing root query or queries\" }` and when we coerced it past validation (dev env) scores were all 0.0.

sam: ah yeah — our rerank expects the `query` (or `queries`) to be at the payload root (or `query` per item in `queries`). If you nest `query` under each document it's treated as opaque metadata, not the signal to score against. that explains zeros. the 422 also comes from the strict schema validator.

alex: steps to repro locally?

maya: 1) hit POST /v1/rerank with that payload. 2) see 422. 3) change payload to: 
```json
{
  \"query\": \"what is X\",
  \"documents\": [{\"id\":\"d1\",\"text\":\"...\"}, {\"id\":\"d2\",\"text\":\"...\"}],
  \"candidates\": [\"d1\", \"d2\"]
}
```
maya: after moving query to root they got valid scores (0.92, 0.11).

ingrid: should we make schema validator return a more helpful error for `query` leaking into documents? file a small patch to mention `query` found in documents and suggest root-level key?

sam: yes please — filing a tiny change in schema-messages repo. also logging an ops ticket: when validation is bypassed we should not silently produce 0 scores; instead return 400 or a warning in the response.

alex: I'll reply to the customer with the repro + quick fix (move query to root). cc @ingrid for follow-up on the nicer error message + platform-team ops ticket.

csbot: (automated) ticket created: CS-4321 (schema-validator UX) — assignee: ingrid.

maya: thanks — keeping this thread open until CS confirms fix worked. :thumbsup:
